test_autotune_random_search: test the Autotuner class with a random algorithm on an LLVM compiler gym environment
run_autotuner_on_llvm_env: run the Autotuner callable on a CompilerEnv to optimize for codesize within a time budget
create_autotuner_instance: create an Autotuner instance with algorithm, optimization_target, and search_time_seconds parameters
test_compiler_gym_llvm_env: test a compiler_gym LLVM environment by resetting it with a cbench benchmark and reward space
verify_autotuner_result: verify an autotuner result's benchmark, walltime, commandline, and episode_reward assertions
